_notes.split: kfold {n_splits, seed} or holdout {val_fraction, seed}. Use the official split if one is given (write it as a holdout).
_notes.group_col: set when rows from the same video / person / scene must stay in the same fold
_notes.metric: accuracy | macro_f1 | weighted_f1 | roc_auc | log_loss  (selection score = mean of fold scores)
_notes.positive_class: only for binary roc_auc; defaults to the second class in sorted order
_notes.epsilon: practical tolerance: a candidate must beat the current best by more than this to be kept. Not a significance test.
_notes.max_run_seconds: total wall-clock per run directory, shared by all its attempts
_notes.test_csv / sample_csv: set to null if official test inputs are not available yet (export becomes pending_inputs)
